question: 各区域订单量。
candidate_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: 销量最高的商品。
candidate_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC LIMIT 10

question: 库存低于 100 的商品。

question: 退款成功金额。
candidate_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'

question: 商品品类销售额。
candidate_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED') AND o.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

question: 每个客户的已支付订单数。
candidate_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS paid_order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED') AND o.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY paid_order_count DESC
